status: IMPLEMENTATION CONTRACT READY; HTML5 implementation still blocked by M6 media-license decision

layers.name: core
layers.rule: pure deterministic state transition logic; no DOM, Canvas, WebAudio, Date, Math.random, setTimeout or requestAnimationFrame

layers.name: scheduler
layers.rule: converts browser time into integer logical ticks; may render at any refresh rate without changing core tick order

layers.name: renderer
layers.rule: read-only consumer of core state; changing assets or interpolation must not alter simulation

layers.name: audio
layers.rule: event consumer only; missed/late audio callbacks must not alter core state

layers.name: input
layers.rule: samples logical button state once per tick and produces held + trigger edges matching NES semantics

timing.definition: one original gameplay-loop iteration synchronized to one PPU NMI
timing.rule: all gameplay constants remain integer tick counts from M7; do not convert to rounded seconds inside the core

browser_scheduler.max_catchup_policy: UI-level choice only; dropped render frames must never imply dropped logical ticks in deterministic tests

coordinates.collision_rule: use integer/fixed-point comparisons matching source order; do not replace with generic physics engine

input.trigger: buttons down now but not on previous logical tick
input.rule: opposite vertical inputs cancel ladder direction checks exactly as source; title hidden codes use trigger equality semantics

rng.zero_seed_policy: do not introduce zero in normal flow
rng.rand16: consume rand8 twice, preserving call order
rng.title_rule: one rand16() per idle title tick before Start

campaign.normal_failure: show game over, then retry same stage
campaign.dream_failure: advance to Day 5 with miss limit unchanged

phone.topic_formula: rand8() % topics_active (original quirk retained in Dream test mode)
phone.miss: after HEAT_3 expiry: reset phone, increment calls_missed

Chatter.effect: replace remembered topic with random active topic

Geek.effect: retreat/block approaching player on same floor

Ghost.effect: Dream pursuit; contact ends Dream without bonus

dream.success: answer one phone; advance; miss allowance +2

observability.snapshot_rule: debug/test snapshots are development-only and must not appear as nerd UI in production

parity.definition: same stage layout + same initial RNG state + same per-tick input sequence must yield the same gameplay-relevant state/event sequence
non_required: same licensed artwork if replacement media is chosen
required: same phone scheduling and requested topics

quirks: Dream has topics_active=0 but phone_reset still executes rand8()%topics_active; output is irrelevant because Dream wisdom is always active.

When wisdom is active, answering uses topicMessages[player_topic]; if player_topic is still 255 this is an unsafe edge case in the original C and must be tested before deciding whether a port should preserve or guard it.
Gameplay timing is not region-normalized even though audio detects NTSC/PAL.
